item.tib: dbal gsas rngam pa'i las rim gyis 'phrin las
item.coloph: gsang sngags rgyud pa'i bla ma'i rgyud phyag rin chen 'phreng rgyud zhes bya ba 'dis / 'dod gdung can gyi bskul ba dang / rang gis bla ma'i yon tan rjes su rtan pa dang / rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs dag ci bzhin du / ba dkor btsun pa rin chen blo gros kyis / shar zang ri mgur du sbyar ba'i dge legs 'phel rgyas shog …
item.note: notice the title is very similar to that of the preceding text, and at least in the beginning, it is in fact the same work. p. 144 constitutes a distinct text, inserted here for some, probably ritual, reason. the title of this one-page text is rgyud phyag. it has the following colophon: ces pas tshul 'di ni rgyal rig dge bshos tsa'i btsun pa // gshen gyi rnal 'byor g.yung drung ye shes kyi yang dben dgon tu sbyar ba 'o … this informs us that the text was composed by one g.yung-drung ye-shes at yang-dben dgon. a vinaya text by the same author is listed in ytkc, p. 78. We also find in the publication entitled zhi khro sgrub skor glegs bam gyi dbu'i rdul len thar lam 'dren byed (cover: zhi khro sgrub skor glegs bam), bsod-nams rgyal-mtshan, delhi 1970, pt. 1, pp. 257-264, a text entitled gsang sngags rgyud phyag rin chen phreng ba, with the author's name given as ba-gor rin-chen blo-gros, composed at shar-pa bzang-ri'i mgul.
